name: You Ji Bu Tan
source:
“Ah~ How did I turn into a girl!”

“Maybe if I sleep it off, I’ll wake up normal again~”

Jia Xu, a shut-in college streamer nicknamed “DanDan,” is mysteriously transformed into a cute girl overnight in the boys’ dorm—and his ridiculous new life begins! Armed with nothing but hormones and confusion, you’ll face your stunned roommates, your lifelong bros, their suddenly awkward girlfriends, and other unlucky classmates who’ve shared the same fate.

Will this farce ever end? Can DanDan change back, or is an even crazier future waiting?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“啊~我怎么变成女孩子了！”

“也许睡一觉就能正常醒来了~”

宅男“蛋蛋”的宅男主播贾旭，一夜之间在男生宿舍神秘变身萌妹子——他荒唐的新生活就此开始！除了荷尔蒙和困惑，你将面对目瞪口呆的室友、终生的兄弟、他们突然尴尬的女朋友，以及其他拥有同样命运的不幸同学。

这场闹剧会结束吗？丹丹能否变回原样，或者更疯狂的未来正在等待着？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047760/]Steam[/url]]
